nodes.name: Called by another workflow
nodes.notes: Takes applications in, each carrying a _config object, and returns them with a decision attached. Called by 01 pipeline and by 06 eval, and by nothing else.

nodes.name: Validate and decide
nodes.notes: _config is destructured off before the item is spread, so the thresholds never end up stored in submissions.raw. The stored payload should be what arrived, not what the pipeline was holding at the time.
